text_block_list.text:
While walking through a department store, 
I spotted Blast Onepiece looking deeply 
distressed.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Hnnnghhhh............
choice_data_list: Is something wrong?
What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Listen to this!
choice_data_list: どうかしたのか？
どうかしたの？
choice_data_list_en: Did something happen?
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I found a hat in a really cool color, but 
the ear size didn't fit... Guess I'd 
better pass on it after all, right?

Come to think of it, for horse girls 
picking a hat, ear size was a major 
factor. Humans never really had to worry 
about that...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it? Are you having some kind 
of trouble too?
choice_data_list: Ah, no, just thinking about hats and ears.

text_block_list.text:
I shared my thoughts with her, mentioning 
that not being a horse girl, I'd never 
given much thought to the relationship 
between hats and ears.
choice_data_list: あ、いや、帽子と耳の関係についてね
choice_data_list_en: Ah, no, just about how hats and ears work together.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Right! For humans, ears and hats 
don't really collide like that!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Wait, but then how do you choose? Isn't 
having way too many options super 
overwhelming?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious! So curious! I really, really 
wanna know how humans pick their hats! I 
wanna watch!
choice_data_list: Er, r-really??

text_block_list.text:
Blast Onepiece's eyes sparkled with pure 
curiosity. ...Pushed along by her 
enthusiastic momentum, I ended up having 
to show her how I shop.
choice_data_list: え、そ、そう？？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, r-really??

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! So that's a human hat shop! None of 
them have ear holes after all. How weird~

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, right! I had a huge shock back in the 
day. It was a hat shop, but they didn't 
sell any hoods! Like, seriously?!
choice_data_list: Well, humans don't wear hoods, after all.

text_block_list.text:
Some people do have sound sensitivities, 
though fewer compared to horse girls—
choice_data_list: 人間はメンコを使わないからね
choice_data_list_en: Humans don't wear racing hoods, you know.

text_block_list.text:
I explained in detail that instead of race 
hoods, such people make use of earplugs or 
earmuffs.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
True, true! But you know, I kinda like the 
shape of human hats too. They're all round 
and... hehe, super cute!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Over there's a human shoe store. Shoes 
aren't all that different, right... Wait, 
huh?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, there IS a difference! There's no 
sign explaining horseshoe customization 
options anywhere!
choice_data_list: Humans don't wear horseshoes, after all.

text_block_list.text:
I gave a detailed explanation for this as 
well: since humans run at a gentler pace 
than horse girls, they can manage without 
horseshoes without putting too much strain 
on their legs.
choice_data_list: 蹄鉄を使うことはないからね
choice_data_list_en: We don't use horseshoes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Makes sense~! If running speeds are 
totally different, the burden on your legs 
and shoes is gonna be totally different 
too.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a human clothing store! Let's see 
here, what's different around here, I 
wonder~?

Blast Onepiece browsed around the shop 
with great curiosity. I decided to take a 
look at the clothes myself.
choice_data_list: (Oh, this... might actually look good.)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what's up? Find something nice?
choice_data_list: （あ、これ……いいかも）
choice_data_list_en: (Oh, this... might be nice.)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Then why not go try it on? Don't be 
shy, go right ahead~♪
choice_data_list: ああ、見つけた！
うん、見つけた！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, found it!
Yeah, I found it!

text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by her cheerful push, I decided 
to head into the fitting room.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Ooh! That looks awesome on you!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It feels super smart and cool! The clean 
lines make you look really sharp!
choice_data_list: Really? That's a relief!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
It feels super smart and cool! The clean 
lines make you look really pretty!
choice_data_list: 本当？よかった！
choice_data_list_en: Really? That's great!

text_block_list.text:
Hearing her words put me at ease. Since I 
was here, maybe I really should buy it... 
—Just as that thought crossed my mind.
choice_data_list: 本当？よかった！
choice_data_list_en: Really? That's great!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: —Ah!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: There's no tail hole!!

She suddenly ducked around behind my back, 
giving me quite a start.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
There really isn't a tail hole! Are you 
okay? Doesn't that feel super cramped?!
choice_data_list: Ah, no, I'm totally fine...?!

text_block_list.text:
Feeling a bit flustered, I explained to 
her that humans don't have tails, so tail 
holes aren't needed, and it doesn't feel 
cramped at all.
choice_data_list: え、いや、大丈夫だよ……！？
choice_data_list_en: Wait, no, I'm totally fine...?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
............Wait, ah! Ah, that's right!! 
When it comes to stuff you 'don't have', 
it's just hard to keep in mind right off 
the bat...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Plus, looking at it just makes me feel 
restless...! Doesn't it feel super tight 
back there?!
choice_data_list: Haha, I'm really okay.

text_block_list.text:
After that amusing exchange, I managed to 
give her a full tour of what "human 
shopping" is like.
choice_data_list: あはは、大丈夫だよ
choice_data_list_en: Ahaha, don't worry, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a ton for today! It was so much fun 
getting to check out all kinds of human 
fashion♪
choice_data_list:
I should learn more about horse girl 
fashion too.

I should learn more about horse girl 
fashion too.

Want me to tell you some relatable human 
quirks?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a ton for today! It was so much fun 
getting to check out all kinds of human 
fashion♪
choice_data_list: 俺もウマ娘のファッションを学んでみるよ
私もウマ娘のファッションを学んでみるよ
人間あるあるも教えてあげようか
choice_data_list_en: I'll try learning more about Umamusume fashion too.
I'll try learning about Umamusume fashion, too.
Shall I tell you about some relatable human quirks too?

text_block_list.text:
I figured that picking up knowledge, even 
on little things, would help me better 
support my trainee horse girls.
choice_data_list: 俺もウマ娘のファッションを学んでみるよ
私もウマ娘のファッションを学んでみるよ
人間あるあるも教えてあげようか
choice_data_list_en: I'll try learning more about Umamusume fashion too.
I'll try learning about Umamusume fashion, too.
Shall I tell you about some relatable human quirks too?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That sounds amazing! Actually, I wanna 
show you around myself!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, I'll introduce you to the shops 
I always go to! C'mon, this way!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, what do you think! Pretty stylish, 
right? They've got even flashier, 
glitterier stuff in the back!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Relatable human quirks?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
What's that! Sounds so interesting! I 
wanna hear! Tell me everything!
choice_data_list: Let's talk about it on our way back, then.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
No way—! There are barely any humans who 
can wiggle their ears on their own?!
choice_data_list: じゃあ帰りながら話そうか
choice_data_list_en: Then let's talk on the way home.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Whoa—! Not having a tail cuts shampoo 
costs in half?! Man, I'm so jealous!

She thoroughly enjoyed listening to all 
sorts of little human quirks the entire 
way back.
